spec.situation_desc: had a loan application declined with no explanation

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Liam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I’m Oskar MacLeod. My loan application was declined and nobody’s explained why. I’m really unhappy with how the bank’s handled this.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll need to verify you first. Full name, please.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Oskar MacLeod.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: And your date of birth and first line of address?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Nineteenth of August 1988, and 14 Birch Road.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. What’s the issue with the application?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s it. I applied last week, got a rejection, and was just left with no explanation. It’s not good enough.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can see it was declined on 12 October. I can’t give you a reason from here.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: So the bank can just say no and leave me to guess?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can put a note on the account that you’ve asked about it.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That doesn’t really address how frustrating this is.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: The next step is that you’ll receive a full written response within 8 weeks.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: What happens in the meantime?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s the process. I can’t say what the response will be, or make any promises about the outcome.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. So I wait for a letter, then.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes. To summarise, I’ve noted your query and you’ll get a full written response within 8 weeks. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, I understand.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Okay. Anything else?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: No.
